exposure: planned mode of delivery (cesarean vs vaginal)
cohort: 8823 women with twin delivery at or beyond 22 weeks of gestation
finding: For twin pregnancies with a cephalic first twin at 32 weeks of gestation and beyond, severe neonatal morbidity was higher in the planned cesarean delivery group compared to planned vaginal delivery, particularly for preterm births.
mod_finding: Planned vaginal delivery was not associated with increased severe neonatal morbidity in cases of breech presenting first twin after 32 weeks of gestation.
